methods.label: Substitute the given value
methods.explanation:
A negative exponent of \(-1\) means to take the reciprocal. Since \(a=\tfrac12\ne0\), we have \(a^{-1}=2\). Substituting this value gives
\[
\frac{2(2)+\frac22}{\frac12}
=\frac{4+1}{\frac12}
=5\cdot2
=10.
\]
The value is \(10\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
